title: MZ SRD Undertale Battle System Ported to MZ !

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi everyone!
Someone commissioned me to make a port of the MV version of SRD Undertale Battle System to RPG Maker MZ. With the permission of the the creator, SRD, I'm uploading this port here for the community:
Spoiler:
Author Permission
Things you should know before everything
You MUST follow SRD terms of use.
Link here
or here
https://someran.dev/rpgmaker/terms/
Do not credit me, Hakuen.
NO A.I was used on any part of the process.
The Port Log
This is a port from the MV version to MZ version of RPG Maker. Just that. It does not contains any new features. Here is a better log of what I did:
Port the plugin to MZ
Fixed an issue that the default Bullet Image parameter was not being applied anywhere on the plugin.
Updated the plugin parameters types according to the RMMZ. Things like, before you would need to write down an image filename on the plugin parameter, now you can properly click to search the image on the right folder.
Everything else is the same. The same help file, same way for setup everything.
Considerations
Although the people that commissioned me asked to port the plugin and also add some new features, I will not add any new features to this public version. I don't want to change what SRD did, just want to share a ported version and make the mz version accessible the same way MV is.
If you find any bugs, I may fix it. But you need to drop a sample project here replicating the error, so I can download it and replicate the problem.
Don't know if I will fix compatibility issues with other plugins. It really depends.
Have fun! Happy RPG Making ^^
